gloss: just after recovering from an illness

definitions.gloss: just after recovering from an illness; convalescence
definitions.explanation: The period just after getting over an illness, when one is better but still weak; also a person in that state.

examples.japanese: {病|や}み{上|あ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧。
examples.english: A body still recovering from illness.

examples.japanese: {病|や}み{上|あ}がりなんだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{無理|むり}しない→無理する：22426_murisuru⟧で。
examples.english: You've only just gotten better, so don't overdo it.

examples.japanese: {病|や}み{上|あ}がり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I'm just over an illness and my strength is down, so I've decided to go home early this week.

notes:
From ⟦{病|や}む→病む：13611_yamu⟧ (to fall ill) and ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to finish). A common reason, or excuse, for taking things easy: {病|や}み{上|あ}がりだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: recovery, the general word
- {病後|びょうご}: the period after an illness — written and formal
